pins.definition: A female child in relation to her parents.

situation: An aging father and his adult daughter share a quiet moment in a sunlit kitchen, packing up the last boxes before she moves into her own home.
subject: the father's female child standing beside him
brief: An older man stands beside a young woman in a sunlit kitchen, his arm gently around her shoulder as they look down together at an open cardboard moving box. She holds a rolled-up framed drawing, smiling slightly at him while golden afternoon light streams across the wooden floor.
